title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - A Gentle Sing-Along for Toddlers
description: A calm, cozy sing-along about the stars in the night sky. Clap and count along with us! #kidssong #nurseryrhyme #toddlersongs #singalong #bedtimesong
characters: Three adorable Black toddlers: Zuri, a 3-year-old girl with deep warm brown skin, round afro puffs tied with soft yellow fabric scrunchies, wearing a sunny yellow t-shirt, denim dungaree shorts and white sneakers; Kofi, a 4-year-old boy with medium-deep brown skin, short dark natural curly hair, wearing a blue t-shirt, grey jogger shorts and red sneakers; and Nala, a 3-year-old girl with deep brown skin, neat cornrow braids, wearing a yellow pinafore dress over a white t-shirt, white tights and pink sneakers

lines: How I wonder what you are
verses.scene: The three toddlers sit on a soft blanket in a garden at dusk, looking up at a sky full of big friendly cartoon stars.

lines: Up above the world so high
Like a diamond in the sky
verses.scene: The toddlers point up at one enormous glowing star, their faces lit warm by its light.

lines: Clap and sing along with me
verses.scene: The toddlers clap their hands together and count on their fingers under the starry sky, grinning at the camera.

lines: Then the traveller in the dark
Thanks you for your tiny spark
verses.scene: A tiny star-shaped lantern glows on the grass beside the toddlers as they cup their hands around its light.

lines: Clap and sing along with me
verses.scene: The toddlers clap their hands together and count on their fingers under the starry sky, grinning at the camera.

pd_source.author: Jane Taylor
pd_source.publication: Rhymes for the Nursery, by Ann and Jane Taylor (London, 1806)
pd_source.public_domain: Published 1806; Jane Taylor died 1824. Expired copyright in the US (pre-1929) and worldwide (life+70 ended 1894).
pd_source.adaptation: Verses 1, 2 and 4 of Taylor's poem, verbatim. Taylor's verse 3 ('When the blazing sun is gone...') is dropped for length. The two-line hook ('Clap and sing along with me / Twinkle, twinkle, one, two, three') is NEWLY WRITTEN for this channel, not Taylor's.

song_style: children's nursery rhyme, gentle calm lullaby, cute female child voice, soft simple melody, twinkly bells, slow bouncy tempo, warm and cozy
